arguments.command: cd $CLONE && git status --porcelain | head -20 && git diff --stat | head && git diff skills/yf-okf/spec/ | head -60

cd $CLONE && sed -n 1,40p skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-BASELINE.md; echo ----; grep -n -i "title" skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-BASELINE.md | head -40; echo ----; grep -n -i -E "reject|report-only|never (fail|block|modif)" skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-BASELINE.md | head -30
cd $CLONE && sed -n 110,135p skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-BASELINE.md; echo ----; sed -n 262,280p skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-BASELINE.md; echo ----; sed -n 470,485p skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-BASELINE.md

cd $CLONE && grep -rn -i -E "\btitle\b" skills/yf-okf skills/yf-okf-hygiene --include=*.md --include=*.py --include=*.toml --include=*.json | grep -v "OKF-BASELINE.md" | head -40; echo ----; grep -rn -i -E "report-only|never (reject|fail)|exit (code|status)" skills/yf-okf/SKILL.md skills/yf-okf/SPEC.md | head -20

cd $CLONE && sed -n 262,300p skills/yf-okf/SPEC.md; echo ----; grep -n -i -E "title|H1|index\.md" skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-YF-EXTENSIONS.md | head -30; echo ----; grep -n -i -E "def check_conformance|missing.*(h1|heading|title)|no-title|untitled" skills/yf-okf/scripts/okf.py | head

cd $CLONE && grep -n "^## " skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-BASELINE.md; echo ----; awk '/^## 3\./,/^## 5\./' skills/yf-okf/spec/OKF-BASELINE.md | head -60; echo ----; grep -n -A6 "REQ-OKF-031\b" skills/yf-okf/SPEC.md | head -20; echo; grep -n -A4 "REQ-OKF-FAM-002\*\*\|REQ-OKF-FAM-002\*" skills/yf-okf/SPEC.md | head -12
